mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies over Verona Community Park with a temperature of 65 degrees.

In city news, the Verona Water Utility is conducting important cross-connection inspections to keep our water supply clean and safe. Also, note that the Verona Senior Center will be closed for the Thanksgiving holiday on November 26 and 27.

We have a busy couple of days ahead. Today, you can check out yoga, ART House 360 events, or trivia at Hop Haus. Tomorrow, look forward to live music at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee, plus the Main Street Trick-Or-Treat event.
Looking at the weekly police report, on October 25, officers responded to a situation where a 40-year-old man was found passed out behind the wheel and was subsequently arrested for O W I.
Today's flavor of the day is the decadent OREO REESE'S Cheesecake. Culver's of Verona is currently open and serving until 10:00 PM tonight, so it is a great time to stop by for a treat.
